mapper.select: SELECT i.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, l.code AS location_code, w.name AS warehouse_name, oi.gift, m.is_virtual, b.production_date AS batch_production_date, b.expiry_date AS batch_expiry_date FROM scm_trade_doc_item i JOIN scm_trade_doc d ON d.id = i.doc_id LEFT JOIN scm_order_item oi ON oi.id = i.order_item_id JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id LEFT JOIN wms_batch b ON b.material_id = i.material_id AND b.batch_no = i.batch_no AND i.batch_no <> '' LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = COALESCE(i.warehouse_id, d.warehouse_id) LEFT JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = i.location_id WHERE i.doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY i.id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO scm_trade_doc_item (doc_id, order_item_id, material_id, warehouse_id, location_id, batch_no, production_date, expiry_date, qty, price, tax_rate, amount, tax_amount, gross_price, discount_share, freight_share, serial_nos, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{i.docId}, #{i.orderItemId}, #{i.materialId}, #{i.warehouseId}, #{i.locationId}, #{i.batchNo}, #{i.productionDate}, #{i.expiryDate}, #{i.qty}, #{i.price}, #{i.taxRate}, #{i.amount}, #{i.taxAmount}, #{i.grossPrice}, COALESCE(CAST(#{i.discountShare} AS DECIMAL(18, 2)), 0), COALESCE(CAST(#{i.freightShare} AS DECIMAL(18, 2)), 0), #{i.serialNos}, #{i.remark}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT i.order_item_id AS "orderItemId", MAX(d.wms_doc_id) AS "wmsDocId" FROM scm_trade_doc_item i JOIN scm_trade_doc d ON d.id = i.doc_id WHERE d.kind = #{kind} AND d.wms_doc_id IS NOT NULL AND i.order_item_id IN #{id} GROUP BY i.order_item_id
